newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds stumble, head for 109-01 area.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds stumble, head for 109-01 area.

text.p: The chart outlook for June T-bond futures has turned negative after a bearish outside day in the previous session and a push to the 109-01 area was likely, technical analysts said on Wednesday.

"Yesterday was a pretty big statement by the market," Tom Hobson, director of technical analysis at Merrill Lynch in London, said. "It was not so much negative, but more that the market can't sustain recovery or bullish activity."
T-bonds were quoted at 109-28 at 1003 GMT, up 2/32 in automated trade. On Tuesday, they traded above and below the previous session's high and low but closed below the low.
"The market is now showing an inability to overcome key resistance," Hobson said.
Short term, T-bonds would revisit the 109-00 to 108-30 level, he said.

"There's pretty significant consolidation support down there along with 109-01 being the 38.2 percent retracement of the recovery," Hobson said. Daily charts show the contract spiking down to a 108-30 low on May 8.
"I don't think this is the restart of the December to April sell-off but the market has maintained its negative bias," Hobson said.
A trader at a British brokerage on LIFFE also noted the outside day.
"The market traded an outside day yesterday which could be the reversal we've been looking for," he said.
"A decline through the uptrend line at 109-22 would send the market back to 109 and a half", he added.
He said in order to look more positive, the market would have to set a higher high above the 110-22 top hit on Tuesday.
Hobson also said resistance there was now solid.
Septermber Eurodollars were quoted at 93.895, up 0.015 in automated trade, with support coming in at Tuesday's 93.870 low.
